questions.stem: 日夜和長輩住在一起，外籍看護往往比任何人都了解他們的需要。
questions.answer: Living with the elderly day and night, foreign care workers often understand their needs better than anyone else.
accepted_answers: Living with elderly people day and night, foreign care workers often know what they need better than anyone else.
Staying with older people day and night, foreign caregivers usually understand their needs better than anyone else does.

patterns: 分詞構句（以 V-ing 片語取代副詞子句）

questions.stem: 這些由台灣家庭聘請的看護，中文也說得越來越流利。
questions.answer: These care workers hired by Taiwanese families are also speaking Chinese more and more fluently.
accepted_answers: These care workers hired by Taiwanese families are also becoming more and more fluent in Chinese.
The care workers employed by Taiwanese families also speak Chinese more and more fluently.

patterns: 分詞片語後位修飾名詞（hired by …）
越來越…（more and more＋形容詞／副詞）

1.explanation_zh: 前半句沒有主詞，主詞和後半句相同（外籍看護），用分詞構句 Living with the elderly day and night。「外籍看護」是 foreign care workers（或 caregivers）。「比任何人都了解」是比較級：understand their needs better than anyone else；better 已是比較級，不加 more。
evidence: 比任何人都了解他們的需要
1.strategy_zh: 兩個子句主詞相同時，可以把前面的子句改成分詞構句：主動用 V-ing，被動用 p.p.。
hints: 切成四段：日夜和長輩住在一起／外籍看護／（往往）比任何人都／了解他們的需要
標的詞彙：elderly（年長的）、foreign（外國的）、care worker（看護）、understand（了解）、need（需要）
句型框架：V-ing …, S + V + better than anyone else

2.explanation_zh: 「由台灣家庭聘請的看護」是前置修飾，英文用過去分詞片語放在名詞後面：these care workers hired by Taiwanese families（看護是被聘請的，用 hired）。「中文也說得越來越流利」的主詞是看護，中文是 speak 的受詞；「越來越流利」用 more and more fluently（修飾動詞用副詞），或 become more and more fluent in Chinese。
evidence: 由台灣家庭聘請的看護
中文也說得越來越流利
2.strategy_zh: 分詞片語修飾名詞時放在名詞後面：主動用 V-ing（people living alone），被動用 p.p.（workers hired by families）。
hints: 切成四段：由台灣家庭聘請的／（這些）看護／中文也說得／越來越流利
標的詞彙：hire（聘請）、family（家庭）、care worker（看護）、speak（說）、fluent（流利的）
句型框架：N + p.p. + by … + be + V-ing + more and more + adv.

references: Living with the elderly day and night, foreign care workers often understand their needs better than anyone else.
Living with elderly people day and night, foreign care workers often know what they need better than anyone else.
Staying with older people day and night, foreign caregivers usually understand their needs better than anyone else does.

common_errors.wrong: Live with the elderly day and night

common_errors.explanation_zh: 前半句沒有主詞，要用分詞構句 Living …（或補成 Because they live …）。

common_errors.wrong: Lived with the elderly day and night
common_errors.right: Living with the elderly day and night
common_errors.explanation_zh: 看護是主動「住在一起」，用現在分詞 living；過去分詞表示被動。
「看護」指人，用 care workers／caregivers；nursing 是「護理工作」。
better 已經是比較級，前面不加 more。
「比任何人都…」說 than anyone else 或 than any other person（單數）。
長輩的需要不只一項，needs 用複數。
間接問句用直述句語序。

traps.literal_error: Live with the elderly day and night, foreign care workers often …
traps.explanation_zh: 前半句中文沒有主詞，英文不能直接放原形動詞；主詞和後半句相同時用分詞構句 Living …。

traps.literal_error: foreign care workers often understand their needs more better than anyone
traps.explanation_zh: well 的比較級是 better，不能再加 more。

bonus.text: No one understands the needs of the elderly better than the foreign care workers who live with them day and night.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用 No one … better than … 的否定比較表示「最了解」，再用關係子句說明看護的身分；句構不同但語意相同，屬加分寫法。

1.restructuring_zh: 前半句「日夜和長輩住在一起」中文沒有主詞，英文要用分詞構句 Living with the elderly day and night，邏輯主詞就是後面的 foreign care workers。

references: These care workers hired by Taiwanese families are also speaking Chinese more and more fluently.
These care workers hired by Taiwanese families are also becoming more and more fluent in Chinese.
The care workers employed by Taiwanese families also speak Chinese more and more fluently.

看護是「被聘請」，用過去分詞 hired。
中文「中文也說得…」是主題句，英文主詞是看護（they），中文（Chinese）是 speak 的受詞。

traps.zh: 由台灣家庭聘請的看護
traps.literal_error: These by Taiwanese families hired care workers …
traps.explanation_zh: 「由…聘請的看護」要改成分詞片語後位修飾：care workers hired by Taiwanese families。

traps.literal_error: are also speaking Chinese more and more fluent
traps.explanation_zh: 修飾動詞 speak 要用副詞 fluently；用形容詞 fluent 時要搭配 become／be fluent in Chinese。

2.restructuring_zh: 「這些由台灣家庭聘請的看護」是前置修飾，英文改成分詞片語後位修飾 these care workers hired by Taiwanese families；「中文也說得越來越流利」以看護為主詞，寫成 are speaking Chinese more and more fluently 或 are becoming more and more fluent in Chinese。

1.translation: Living with the elderly day and night, foreign caregivers often understand their needs better than anyone else.
1.explanation_zh: 前半句主詞與後半句相同（外籍看護），用分詞構句 Living with … 表原因；「比任何人都了解」用比較級 better than anyone else；「長輩」譯 the elderly；「日夜」譯 day and night。

2.translation: These caregivers hired by Taiwanese families are also speaking Chinese more and more fluently.
2.explanation_zh: 「由台灣家庭聘請的看護」用過去分詞片語 hired by Taiwanese families 修飾 caregivers（省略關係子句）；「越來越流利」用 more and more fluently，搭配進行式表示變化中；也可寫 have become more and more fluent in Chinese。信心 medium 是因為時態可用進行式或完成式。

issues_zh: （小建議，不影響判定）R0／R1 和本譯文的 understand their needs 中，their 緊跟在主詞 foreign care workers 之後，字面上可能被讀成看護自己的需要；語境下仍清楚，但可在 P4 accepted 補 understand the needs of the elderly／what the elderly need（加分寫法已用這種寫法）。

1.translation: Living with the elderly day and night, foreign caregivers often understand their needs better than anyone else.
1.explanation_zh: 「日夜和長輩住在一起」是伴隨的原因，用現在分詞片語 Living with ... 作句首修飾，主詞 foreign caregivers 與分詞動作一致；「比任何人都了解」用比較級 better than anyone else。

2.translation: These caregivers, who are hired by Taiwanese families, also speak Chinese more and more fluently.
2.explanation_zh: 「由台灣家庭聘請的」用非限定關係子句（被動）補充說明；「越來越流利」用 more and more fluently；「也」放在動詞前。中文沒有時間副詞，用現在簡單式描述持續趨勢。

issues_zh: 備註：「往往」沒有放進任何一個部分，漏譯 often 不會被扣分（不影響通過）。
備註：我自然寫出的是完整關係子句 who are hired by Taiwanese families，而不是縮減的過去分詞片語 hired by …；中文「由…聘請的」沒有強制縮減成分詞，所以標的句型 PART 在盲譯裡不一定被引出（part 1 的 accepted 本身也收了 who are hired by），因此我沒有勾 PART。

problems: 第 2 題盲譯沒有用到標的句型 ['PART']：中文題目沒有自然引出這個句型（SPEC §5.7）

status_reason: blind_solver:B 未通過：第 2 題盲譯沒有用到標的句型 ['PART']：中文題目沒有自然引出這個句型（SPEC §5.7）；判定者人工審查（第 1 輪）：同意退回。第 2 題「由台灣家庭聘請的看護」同樣自然引出完整的關係子句（驗證者 B 的盲譯 These caregivers, who are hired by Taiwanese families, …），第 1 部分 accepted 本身也收了 who are／that are hired by，標的句型 PART（過去分詞片語後位修飾）沒有被中文唯一引出，標的句型和評分規準互相矛盾。重生時改寫中文讓它自然引出分詞片語，或把這一句的標的句型改為關係子句（REL）。第 1 題沒有問題（「往往」沒有放進任何一個部分，可順便調整）。
